item.title: 200-year-old botanical mystery solved near Nieuwoudtville
item.description: A plant species believed to have been lost for nearly 200 years has been rediscovered near Nieuwoudtville in the Northern Cape, offering fresh evidence of South Africa’s extraordinary botanical richness.

item.title: WATCH | Why hoof trimming goats and sheep can’t be ignored
item.description: Picture this: You’re walking through your paddock and you notice a few of your goats lagging behind the flock. They’re not grazing as actively, seem reluctant to move and their overall condition appears to be declining. What you might be witnessing is one of the most overlooked yet critical aspects of small-stock management – hoof health.

item.title: Doctoral study highlights postharvest food waste crisis and solutions in SA
item.description: South Africa faces one of the most troubling contradictions in the modern world: while over six in ten households struggle to put food on the table, thousands of tonnes of fresh fruit and vegetables are being dumped as waste every single year.

item.title: Free State reports 35 new cases of FMD
item.description: Following South Africa’s milestone in animal health on Friday, 6 February with the delivery of its first locally produced foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine in 20 years, the Free State Department of Agriculture and Rural Development confirmed 35 additional cases of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) a day later.
